text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp to hone our skills begins today.
Fine Motion had been looking forward to this day
for the longest time, and...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah... The training camp lodge is over here!
...Um, is this the entrance? Are the sleeping quarters separate?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought this when I first saw the dorms too,
but people in Japan are truly masters of using space!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, room inspection is complete.
There are no issues. As for your luggage...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I shall carry it myself.
Please proceed with the rest as usual."

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I shall await your call, then.
With that, the bodyguards lined up unobtrusively, keeping a respectful distance from Fine Motion.
choice_data_list: I hope you don't get heatstroke...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"They're professionals, so they'll be fine!
They train in harsh environments, after all."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's get right down to training today,
no holding back, please♪
choice_data_list: With our sights set on the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hip, hip, hooray!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Tch! Don't just stand there!"

text_block_list.name: Chatting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sowwy~...
So scaaary...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Shakur,
looks like a severe storm warning's in effect, huh?

Air Shakur, a Double Crown Umamusume.
However, her subsequent race results have not been very favorable.
To someone who puts data above all else, she probably sees the reason, but...
choice_data_list: Maybe there's a wall that just can't be broken.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...That must be
very painful for you."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, if you hurt everyone you touch like Gáe Bulg,
it's going to get lonely.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Wait just a moment, okay!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness?! That is dangerous, please stop!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"However, Gáe Bulg is
a very dangerous weapon..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur!
Let's have a water fight!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I won't. You're annoying. Get lost.
You're an eyesore.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but it feels so youthful~.
And you know, even if it fades away, it's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If it's just 'splashing water,'
can't you do that on your own?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Wait, at least let me put my PC down!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just for five seconds, okay?
Five, four, three, two...

Thanks to Fine Motion's forceful way of roping her in,
Air Shakur's mood seemed to have settled down a bit.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
...Her Highness always does things
that are bad for my heart...

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Even when meeting Lady Air Shakur for the first time,
despite knowing the background check results, you somehow approached her with high spirits...

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: It is fortunate that Lady Air Shakur is far more intelligent than the background report suggested, however—

...Listening to the Captain of the Royal Guard's muttering for a while,
my thoughts drifted to the upcoming summer training camp.
